content.title: Colombia Secures Second U17 South American Title Over Nine Man Argentina
content.text: Published Apr 20, 2026 - 08:02 Last Update Apr 20, 2026 - 08:02 Colombia's historic 3-0 victory against Brazil secured their spot in the South American U17 final against Argentina - credit Conmebol Smallest Font Largest Font Colombia's national youth team captured its second historic CONMEBOL U17 South American Championship title after defeating Argentina on Sunday, April 19, 2026. The decisive match took place at the Cancha Conmebol in Luque, Paraguay, where the Tricolor secured a dominant victory to earn their second star.The Colombian side displayed a clinical performance, punctuated by a late scoring surge and a strategic advantage following multiple disciplinary issues for the Argentine squad. Argentina finished the championship final with only nine men on the pitch after receiving two late red cards, according to infobae.com. Discipline proved costly for the Albiceleste, starting in the 62nd minute when Marcos Ortiz received a yellow card for striking Miguel Agámez in the face. The situation worsened in the 73rd minute when Mendizabal was sent off following a heavy foul on Colombia's Anderson Murillo. Colombia capitalized on the man advantage despite a missed opportunity by Maturana in the 76th minute. The scoring was finalized in the 83rd minute when José Escorcia, who provided assists earlier in the match, executed a successful counterattack to net the fourth goal for the Tricolor. The match concluded under tense conditions as Argentina saw two more players sent off in the 88th minute. Goalkeeper Luigi Ortiz preserved the clean sheet for Colombia earlier in the second half by diving to stop a goal-bound effort from the Argentine offense in the 65th minute.Coach Fredy Hurtado utilized his bench late in the game to solidify the result, introducing Gilberto Saavedra and Carlos Rodríguez. This victory marks Colombia's second continental title at this level, following their successful elimination of Brazil in the semi-final round. 0 Like 0 Dislike 0 Funny 0 Angry 0 Sad 0 Wow
